ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail the exact verification algorithm for the VerkleProof within the consensus layer; it delegates to the execution engine.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the execution engine implements full Verkle proof verification including IPA verification. The consensus layer treats this as a black-box trusted oracle.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between execution_witness in ExecutionPayload and execution_witness_root in ExecutionPayloadHeader is implied but the hashing scheme is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume execution_witness_root is the hash_tree_root of the ExecutionWitness container, consistent with other SSZ container commitments in the spec.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine is assumed to correctly verify Verkle proofs and state diffs without consensus-layer re-verification.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised execution engine could accept invalid state transitions, allowing theft of funds or state corruption.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge valid IPA proofs for incorrect state diffs given the cryptographic assumptions of the Verkle tree scheme.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Forged proofs could allow invalid state transitions to appear valid, enabling stateless validators to accept corrupted state.

implicit_assumptions.description: The MAX_STEMS (65536), VERKLE_WIDTH (256), and MAX_COMMITMENTS_PER_STEM (33) limits are sufficient to represent all state changes in a single block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Blocks requiring more state changes than these limits allow could not be represented, potentially causing liveness failures.
